item.title: Kim Min-seok, the first to visit DJ’s grave: “Lee Jae-myung’s government stands on Kim Dae-jung’s path” (DJ 먼저 찾은 김민석 “이재명 정부는 김대중 노선 위에 서 있다”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, the first to visit DJ’s grave: “Lee Jae-myung’s government stands on Kim Dae-jung’s path” (DJ 먼저 찾은 김민석 “이재명 정부는 김대중 노선 위에 서 있다”)

Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister who is running in the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, visited the grave of former President Kim Dae-jung on the 17th as his first official schedule after registering as a candidate. He stated, “Lee Jae-myung’s government stands on Kim Dae-jung’s path,” and added, “I will carry on the former President’s will to create a ruling party worthy of its name.” (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 후보 등록 후 첫 공식 일정으로 17일 김대중 전 대통령 묘역을 참배하고 “이재명 정부는 김대중 노선 위에 서 있다”며 “김 전 대통령의 뜻을 이어 집권당다운 집권당을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

On this morning, former Prime Minister Kim visited the gravesite of former President Kim Dae-jung and Mrs. Lee Hee-ho at the Seoul National Cemetery in Dongjak-gu, Seoul. Kim Jong-dae, the eldest grandson of former President Kim, accompanied him. (김 전 총리는 이날 오전 서울 동작구 국립서울현충원을 찾아 김 전 대통령과 이희호 여사의 묘역을 참배했다. 김 전 대통령의 맏손자인 김종대씨가 동행했다.)

In the guestbook, former Prime Minister Kim wrote, “Based on the spirit of the Constitution, I will work to build a Korea that is irreplaceable.” (김 전 총리는 방명록에 “헌법 정신의 바탕 위에 대체 불가 대한민국을 만들어 가겠습니다”라고 적었다.)

After the visit, former Prime Minister Kim met with reporters and said, “When I was out of office, former President Kim told me, ‘Focus on retreat and self-cultivation,’ and that advice helped me endure for 18 years. Being able to overcome difficulties was thanks to the former President’s teachings and encouragement.” (김 전 총리는 참배를 마치고 기자들과 만나 “야인으로 있을 때 김 전 대통령께서 ‘퇴수(退修·물러나 수양함)를 잘해라’라고 해 주신 말씀으로 18년을 버틸 수 있었다”며 “어려움을 이겨낼 수 있었던 것은 김 전 대통령의 가르침과 격려 덕분이었다”고 했다.)

He continued, “I consider it an honor to challenge for the leadership of the Democratic Party, which former President Kim established on a solid foundation,” and added, “I am grateful to my eternal teacher, former President Kim, and to Mrs. Lee.” (이어 “김 전 대통령이 반석 위에 올려놓은 민주당 대표에 도전하게 된 것을 영광으로 생각한다”며 “영원한 스승이신 김 전 대통령과 이 여사님께 감사드린다”고 했다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim recalled, “During the 1997 presidential election, when former President Kim won, I sat in the passenger seat of his car for an entire month, accompanying him, and I was in charge of the practical work to create a proper ruling party. When we came up with the name ‘Millennium Democratic Party,’ former President Kim was so delighted.” (김 전 총리는 “김 전 대통령이 승리한 1997년 대선 때 한 달 내내 차 옆자리에 앉아서 김 전 대통령을 수행했고, 집권당다운 집권당을 만드는 실무를 맡았다”며 “‘새천년민주당’이라는 이름을 만들었을 때 김 전 대통령이 그렇게 기뻐하셨다”고 회고했다.)

He further stated, “Lee Jae-myung’s sovereign government stands on Kim Dae-jung’s path. I will faithfully follow that will and create a ruling party worthy of its name.” (그러면서 “이재명 국민주권정부는 김대중의 노선 위에 서 있다”며 “그 뜻을 잘 따라 집권당다운 집권당을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "380 Million Won in Donations Overnight... Grateful to Tears" (정청래 “하룻밤 새 3억8000만원 후원금… 눈물나게 고마워”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "380 Million Won in Donations Overnight... Grateful to Tears" (정청래 “하룻밤 새 3억8000만원 후원금… 눈물나게 고마워”)

Jung Cheong-rae, a former leader running in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership election, announced on the 17th that 380 million won in donations had been raised in just one day after registering as a candidate. At a meeting with party members, he highlighted the introduction of the "one-person-one-vote system for both delegates and paid members" as an achievement from his first term as party leader. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 정청래 전 대표는 17일 후보 등록 하루 만에 후원금으로 3억8000만원이 모였다고 밝혔다. 당원들을 만난 자리에서는 ‘대의원·권리당원 모두 1인 1표제’를 도입한 것을 첫 당대표 시절 업적으로 내세웠다.)

In a Facebook post at 10:43 a.m. that day, Jung wrote, "Something major has happened," adding, "Yesterday, on a YouTube broadcast, I said my donations were 20 million won short, but overnight, 380 million won was deposited. (Exceeding the limit) I have to return 360 million won." (정 전 대표는 이날 오전 10시 43분 페이스북에 글을 올려 “큰일 났다”며 “어제(16일) 유튜브 방송에서 제 후원금 2000만원이 부족하다고 했는데, 하룻밤 새 3억8000만원이 입금(됐다). (한도를 넘어서서) 3억6000만원을 돌려줘야 한다”고 했다.)

Jung continued, "Since it's the weekend, the account isn't closed," and said, "I'm truly grateful, but please stop now ㅠㅠ." He also noted, "The party leadership candidate donation account will be set up soon, so please send donations there instead." (정 전 대표는 이어 “주말이라 계좌가 닫히질 않는다”며 “정말 감사한데요. 이제 그만ㅠㅠ”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “당대표 (후보) 후원 계좌를 곧 만드니 (후원금은) 그곳으로 (보내 달라)”고 했다.)

Eight minutes later, Jung posted another update, stating, "It seems some YouTube channel broadcast yesterday that my donation account still needed 20 million won. After seeing that, a whopping 380 million won poured in overnight." (정 전 대표는 8분 뒤 글을 새로 올려 “어제 어느 유튜브에서 제 후원 계좌가 2000만원 아직 덜 찼다고 방송을 했나 보다. 그 방송을 보고 하룻밤 새 무려 3억8000만원이 쏟아져 입금됐다”고 다시 밝혔다.)

He added, "I have to return 360 million won one by one. It's a hassle, but I'm grateful to tears." (그러면서 “3억6000만원을 일일이 돌려드려야 한다. 번거롭지만 눈물 나게 고마운 일”이라고 했다.)

Jung then named pro-Jung candidates running in the supreme council election, asking supporters to send donations to them instead. He said, "Please stop sending to my account for now; if you could send over the weekend to the donation accounts of Representatives Choi Min-hee, Lee Seong-yoon, and Han Min-soo, I'd appreciate it." (정 전 대표는 이어서 최고위원 선거에 출마한 친청계 후보들을 거명하면서 이들에게도 후원금을 보내 달라고 했다. 그는 “제 계좌로는 그만 보내시고, 최민희, 이성윤, 한민수 의원 후원 계좌로 주말에는 보내주면 감사하겠다”고 했다.)

He also requested that once the party leadership candidate donation account is opened, supporters donate to him again. "As a party leadership candidate, I can separately raise 150 million won," he said. "The account will open soon, so please send it there. Thank you so much." (그는 그러면서 당대표 후보 후원금 계좌가 열리면 다시 자기에게 후원금을 보내 달라고 했다. 그는 “당대표 후보의 후원금은 따로 1억5000만원을 모금할 수 있다”며 “곧 열 테니, 그 계좌로 보내 주시면 고맙겠다. 정말 감사하다”고 했다.)

That morning, Jung visited party members in Buk-gu and Seo-gu, Gwangju. He remarked, "This is the first party convention held under the one-person-one-vote system for delegates and paid members," adding, "When I served as party leader for a year, I thought people would say, 'Thank you for judicial reform,' 'Thank you for media reform,' or 'Thank you for prosecutorial reform.' But at Jikjisa Temple, two monks looked at me and said, 'Chairman, thank you for implementing the one-person-one-vote system.'" He continued, "Wherever I go, people thank me for the one-person-one-vote system. I realized how significant this is." (정 전 대표는 이날 오전 광주 북구와 서구를 잇따라 찾아 지역 당원들을 만났다. 그는 “이번이 (대의원·권리당원) 1인 1표로 시행되는 첫 번째 전당대회”라며 “제가 당대표 1년 하면서 저한테 ‘아이고, 사법 개혁해 줘서 고마워요’ ‘언론 개혁해 줘서 고마워요’ ‘검찰 개혁해 줘서 고마워요’ 이럴 줄 알았는데, 직지사라는 절에서 스님 두 분이 저를 보면서 ‘대표님, 1인 1표제 해 주셔서 감사합니다’라고 했다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “어디를 가든 저를 보면 1인 1표 해 줘서 고맙다고 한다”며 “이게 정말 큰 것이구나 하는 생각이 들었다”고 했다.)

Jung further argued that former President Kim Dae-jung laid the internet infrastructure nationwide, which enabled South Korea to become a leader in pandemic response by leveraging the internet during the COVID-19 outbreak under the Moon Jae-in administration. He also claimed that Kim's doubling or tripling of funding for culture and arts made South Korea a cultural powerhouse. (정 전 대표는 이어서 김대중 전 대통령이 전국에 인터넷을 깔았고, 그래서 문재인 정부 때 코로나19가 유행하자 인터넷을 활용한 방역으로 방역 선진국이 될 수 있었다고 주장했다. 또 김 전 대통령이 문화·예술계 지원금을 두세 배로 늘려서 한국이 문화 강국이 될 수 있었다고 했다.)

Jung emphasized that under the "Lee Jae-myung administration," South Korea is advancing as an "irreplaceable Republic of Korea." He stressed, "Without President Lee Jae-myung, we would have been in big trouble. To make the Lee Jae-myung administration a success and create the fifth Democratic Party president, we must unite tightly." (정 전 대표는 그러면서 이재명 정부에서 한국이 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’으로 나아가고 있다며, “이재명 대통령이 아니었으면 큰일 날 뻔했다. 이재명 정부를 성공시키고, 다섯 번째 민주당 대통령을 만들어 내려면 우리가 똘똘 뭉쳐야 한다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok, Visiting Roh Moo-hyun's Grave, Says "I Apologize to President Roh and His Supporters... I Was Mistaken at the Time" (노무현 묘역 참배한 김민석 “노 대통령과 노사모에 사과… 당시 제가 오판했다”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, Visiting Roh Moo-hyun's Grave, Says "I Apologize to President Roh and His Supporters... I Was Mistaken at the Time" (노무현 묘역 참배한 김민석 “노 대통령과 노사모에 사과… 당시 제가 오판했다”)

Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister running in the leadership election of the Democratic Party of Korea, visited the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun on the 17th and once again apologized regarding the so-called "Candidates Unification Council" incident during the 2002 presidential election. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 17일 노무현 전 대통령 묘역을 참배하고 2002년 대선 때의 이른바 ‘후단협(대통령 후보 단일화 협의회) 사태’와 관련해 거듭 사과했다.)

The former Prime Minister Kim visited Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, that afternoon to pay respects at former President Roh's grave. He was accompanied by former South Gyeongsang Governor Kim Kyoung-soo, who had served as Roh's final aide. (김 전 총리는 이날 오후 경남 김해시 봉하마을을 찾아 노 전 대통령 묘역을 참배했다. 노 전 대통령을 마지막으로 수행한 김경수 전 경남지사가 동행했다.)

Kim wrote in the guestbook, "I will always cherish President Roh's magnanimous heart and dream of unifying politics, and move forward." (김 전 총리는 방명록에 “대통령님의 큰 가슴과 통합 정치의 꿈을 늘 새기고 나아가겠습니다”라고 적었다.)

In a post on Facebook and X (formerly Twitter) prior to the visit, Kim stated, "As a candidate for party leadership, visiting President Roh Moo-hyun's grave today stirs a mix of emotions for me." He described former President Roh as "someone I deeply wronged, who embraced me warmly, and whom I miss immensely." (김 전 총리는 참배에 앞서 페이스북과 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “당대표 후보로서 노무현 대통령님 묘역을 참배하는 오늘은 특별히 만감히 교차한다”고 했다. 그는 노 전 대통령을 “크게 죄송했고, 넓게 품어 주셨고, 몹시 그리운 분”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "I once again bow my head and sincerely apologize to President Roh Moo-hyun, who was emotionally hurt during the 2002 candidate unification and party departure process, and to all members of Roh's supporters and others." He added, "At that time, due to my misjudgment and shortcomings, I endured 18 years as a political outsider." (이어 “2002년 후보 단일화와 탈당 과정에서 마음의 상처를 입으신 노무현 대통령님과 노사모를 비롯한 모든 분께 다시 머리 숙여 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다. 그러면서 “당시 저의 오판과 부족으로 18년의 야인 시절을 겪었다”고 했다.)

Kim said, "President Roh reflected on that period in 2002 in his autobiography, and when I became a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party and visited Bongha in 2008, he told me, 'An official reconciliation was achieved by the mandate of the delegates.' He was a profound and great person." He also noted, "The experience of 2002 taught me that, rather than political engineering, the power of the public and party members is the essence of victory." (김 전 총리는 “노 대통령님께서는 자서전을 통해 2002년 당시를 회고하시고, 제가 (민주당) 최고위원이 돼 봉하를 찾은 2008년에는 ‘대의원들의 명령에 의해 공식 화해가 이뤄졌다’고 말씀해주셨다”며 “깊고 큰 분이셨다”고 했다. 또 “2002년의 경험은 제게 정치공학보다 대중의 힘, 당원의 힘이 승리의 본질임을 가르쳐 줬다”고 했다.)

Kim stated, "I have come this far through the door of political return that President Roh opened with great tolerance," and "I will always remember the lessons from that time and work to realize the politics of unity and a world where people thrive, as President Roh dreamed." He concluded his post, "President Roh Moo-hyun! I am sorry and grateful." (김 전 총리는 “노 대통령님께서 큰 관용으로 품어 주신 정치 복귀의 문을 지나 오늘까지 왔다”며 “그때의 교훈을 늘 새기고 노 대통령님께서 꿈꾸신 통합의 정치, 사람 사는 세상을 이뤄가겠다”고 했다. 그는 “노무현 대통령님! 죄송하고 감사합니다”라며 글을 마쳤다.)

Kim sparked controversy in 2002 when, as former President Roh's approval ratings as the Democratic Party's presidential candidate declined, he left the Democratic Party on October 17, 2002, about two months before the election, and moved to lawmaker Chung Mong-joon's presidential campaign. This occurred amid intensifying internal strife in the Democratic Party, as non-Roh lawmakers had formed the Candidates Unification Council in early October, demanding the unification of Roh and Representative Chung's presidential candidacies—effectively calling for Roh's withdrawal as a candidate. Kim later participated in the founding of the National Unity 21 party, led by Chung, in November of that year. Although the unification was achieved, resulting in Roh becoming the candidate, Kim faced criticism as a "political turncoat" during this process. (김 전 총리는 2002년 민주당 대선 후보였던 노 전 대통령의 지지율이 떨어지자, 대선을 두 달여 앞둔 2002년 10월 17일 민주당을 탈당해 정몽준 의원의 대선 캠프로 옮겨 파문을 일으켰다. 민주당의 비노무현계 의원들이 10월 초 노 전 대통령과 정 대표의 대선 후보 단일화, 사실상 노 전 대통령의 후보 사퇴를 요구하는 후단협을 만들어 당 내분이 격화되고 있던 때였다. 김 전 총리는 그해 11월 정 의원의 당인 국민통합21 창당에 참여했다. 단일화는 성사됐고 노 전 대통령이 후보가 되는 것으로 귀결됐으나, 김 전 총리는 이 과정에서 ‘철새 정치인’이라는 비난을 받았다.)

item.title: S. Korean PM Visits Gosiwon, Says "Heatwave Directly Linked to Lives... Pay Close Attention" (쪽방촌 찾은 韓총리 “폭염은 생명과 직결… 세심히 살펴 달라”)
item.description:
S. Korean PM Visits Gosiwon, Says "Heatwave Directly Linked to Lives... Pay Close Attention" (쪽방촌 찾은 韓총리 “폭염은 생명과 직결… 세심히 살펴 달라”)

Prime Minister Han Sung-sook visited a gosiwon (a residential area of small, single-room units) near Seoul Station in Yongsan-gu, Seoul on the 17th to inspect preparations for the heatwave and urged officials to pay close attention to the residents. (한성숙 국무총리가 17일 서울 용산구 서울역 인근 쪽방촌을 찾아 폭염 대비 상황을 살피고 공무원들에게 주민들을 세심히 살펴 달라고 당부했다.)

The Prime Minister's Office stated, "This visit was arranged as the full-fledged summer heat begins, allowing the Prime Minister to personally check on the welfare of gosiwon residents vulnerable to the summer heat and to review the implementation of the 'Summer Season Vulnerable Group Protection Measures' announced last June." (총리실은 “이번 방문은 본격적인 무더위가 시작됨에 따라 여름철 더위에 취약한 쪽방 주민의 안부를 총리가 직접 살피고, 지난 6월 발표한 ‘여름철 취약계층 보호 대책’의 추진 상황을 점검하기 위해 마련됐다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han first visited the "On-gi Storage," a facility for supplying daily necessities, to check whether cooling supplies such as electric fans and ice water were being adequately provided, and then visited the "Night Heat Shelter," an overnight cooling shelter for residents, to inspect the operation of the cooling facilities. (한 총리는 먼저 생필품 지원 시설인 ‘온기창고’를 찾아 선풍기, 얼음물 등 냉방용품이 잘 지원되고 있는지를 점검하고, 주민들의 야간 무더위 쉼터인 ‘밤더위대피소’를 찾아 냉방 시설 가동 상태를 살폈다.)

Afterward, Prime Minister Han visited a gosiwon unit where a resident with limited mobility lived and had a conversation. Prime Minister Han asked about the resident's health condition and any inconveniences in daily life, and urged him to ask for help from neighbors in case of urgent difficulties. The resident said, "It is an honor as a citizen that you have taken the time to visit despite your busy schedule." (이후 한 총리는 거동이 불편한 주민이 사는 쪽방을 찾아 이야기를 나눴다. 한 총리는 주민의 건강 상태와 생활에 불편함은 없는지를 묻고, 긴급한 어려움이 있을 때는 주변에 요청해 달라고 당부했다. 이 주민은 “바쁘신 데 걸음해 주시니 국민의 한 사람으로서 영광”이라고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han then visited the gosiwon counseling center to check the overall situation and support status of the gosiwon and encouraged the staff. Prime Minister Han urged, "Since the heatwave is not just an inconvenience but an emergency situation directly linked to lives, please conduct thorough safety inspections and provide more meticulous protection so that residents can have a safe and cool summer." (한 총리는 이어서 쪽방상담소를 찾아 쪽방촌의 전반적인 상황과 지원 상황을 살피고 관계자들을 격려했다. 한 총리는 “폭염은 단순한 불편이 아니라 생명과 직결되는 비상 상황인 만큼, 주민들이 안전하고 시원한 여름을 보낼 수 있게 안전 점검을 철저히 하고 더욱 세심히 보호해 달라”고 당부했다.)

Prime Minister Han added, "Although we have prepared and implemented measures to protect vulnerable groups for the summer season last June, it may still be insufficient for the public to feel them on the ground. I ask that local government officials and staff at the gosiwon counseling centers directly visit residents to ensure that those in need do not miss out on the necessary support." (한 총리는 이어 “지난 6월 여름철 취약 계층 보호 대책을 마련해 시행하고 있지만, 현장에서 국민이 체감하는 데는 부족할 수 있다”며 “지방자치단체 공무원과 쪽방상담소 관계자들이 직접 주민들을 찾아서 어려움에 처한 주민들이 필요한 지원을 놓치지 않고 받을 수 있게 살펴 달라”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han also requested the Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Seoul Metropolitan Government, "Please develop not only support for food, clothing, and shelter but also various community activities and cultural programs, and pay close attention so that private sector linkage and cooperation can be activated in that process." (한 총리는 또 보건복지부와 서울시에 “의식주 지원뿐 아니라 다양한 커뮤니티 활동, 문화 프로그램을 개발하고, 그 과정에서 민간과 연계·협력이 활성화될 수 있도록 많은 관심을 가져 달라”고 당부했다.)

item.title: President Lee Launches ‘Committee of Light’ on Constitution Day… “National Sovereignty That Blocked the December 3 Martial Law Will Be Recorded in History Forever” (李대통령, 제헌절 맞아 ‘빛의 위원회’ 출범… “12·3 계엄 막아선 국민 주권, 역사에 영원히 기록”)
item.description:
President Lee Launches ‘Committee of Light’ on Constitution Day… “National Sovereignty That Blocked the December 3 Martial Law Will Be Recorded in History Forever” (李대통령, 제헌절 맞아 ‘빛의 위원회’ 출범… “12·3 계엄 막아선 국민 주권, 역사에 영원히 기록”)

President Lee Jae-myung held a ‘Citizen Invitation Event to Commemorate the Launch of the Committee of Light’ at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House on the 17th, Constitution Day. (이재명 대통령이 제헌절인 17일 청와대 영빈관에서 ‘빛의 위원회 출범 기념 시민 초청 행사’를 개최했다.)

In his opening remarks, President Lee said, “I have always wondered why Constitution Day, which marks the creation of the supreme norm of the Republic of Korea, was not a public holiday,” adding, “This is clear evidence that the state has treated the meaning of the constitution and the weight of the constitution lightly.” He continued, “The core ideology of the constitution is that ‘the state is the people, and all power comes from the people,’” and stated, “As we have re-designated Constitution Day as a national public holiday starting this year, I will create a society where the supreme norm, the constitution, is genuinely respected.” <<> Furthermore, he said, “Public officials, as representatives of the people, bear immense responsibilities proportional to the size of their authority,” and emphasized, “Allocated budgets and authority must be used solely for the future of the people and the state, and I too am constantly striving for this.” <<> President Lee stated, “The midnight emergency martial law of December 3, 2024, made us realize the harsh reality that the threat to democracy is not just a historical event of the past, but can be repeated at any time even today.” He added, “At the moment when martial law helicopters split the sky and special forces broke into the National Assembly windows, thanks to the actions of great citizens who braved the bitter cold and rushed to the scene, we were able to protect the constitution and democracy.” Furthermore, he declared that December 3rd would be designated as a national memorial day called ‘National Sovereignty Day’. <<> The event also featured a special screening of director Lee Myung-se’s documentary film ‘Ran 12.3’. The director took the stage and said, “Usually, when a film is released, I meet the audience with the actors, so it was a bit disappointing to be alone,” adding, “It is meaningful to hold this screening today with the President and First Lady, who are the real lead actors of this film, and the citizens who did not stop on that asphalt night.” <<> Introducing the film, the director said, “Without typical narration or interviews, it is an audiovisual symphony that plays the fear and nightmare of that night, and the rhythm of the citizens who shattered it, using only music, sound, and visual images,” and added, “If past revolutions were images of red blood, the December 3 revolution is an image of brilliant multicolored light and solidarity.” <<> The event was attended by about 100 people, including Park Mi-kyung, Chairperson of the Committee of Light, civic activists such as retired Army Brigadier General Choi Hwa-sik who confronted martial law troops in front of the National Assembly on the day of the martial law, and key cabinet and Cheong Wa Dae officials including Minister of Finance Koo Yun-cheol. (이 대통령은 모두 발언에서 “대한민국 최고 규범인 헌법을 만든 제헌절이 그동안 공휴일이 아니었던 것에 대해 늘 의문이었다”며 “이는 국가가 제헌의 의미와 헌법의 무거움을 가볍게 여겨왔다는 명백한 반증”이라고 했다. 이어 “헌법의 핵심 이념은 ‘국가가 곧 국민이며, 모든 권력은 국민으로부터 나온다’는 것”이라며 “올해부터 제헌절을 국가 공휴일로 재지정한 만큼, 최고 규범인 헌법이 실질적으로 존중받는 사회를 만들겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: South Korean Premier Issues Urgent Directive for ‘Heavy Rain Preparedness’ (韓총리, ‘집중호우 대비’ 긴급 지시)
item.description:
South Korean Premier Issues Urgent Directive for ‘Heavy Rain Preparedness’ (韓총리, ‘집중호우 대비’ 긴급 지시)

With forecasts indicating the heaviest and most intense rainfall of this summer centered on the central region starting early on the 18th, Prime Minister Han Seung-sook issued an urgent directive to relevant authorities on the night of the 17th to maintain emergency preparedness. (18일 새벽부터 중부지방을 중심으로 올여름 들어 가장 강하고 많은 비가 내릴 것으로 전망되자, 한성숙 국무총리가 17일 밤 관계 기관에 비상 대비를 긴급 지시했다.)

Prime Minister Han stated, “The ground has been weakened by recent rains, raising concerns over soil runoff, landslides, rockfalls, and retaining wall collapses,” and emphasized, “Strengthen safety measures and inspect resident evacuation systems.” She specifically added, “Conduct emergency inspections to ensure areas previously damaged by flooding are not affected again by this rainfall, and take all necessary steps to secure safety.” (한 총리는 “그동안 내린 비로 지반이 약해져 토사 유출, 산사태, 낙석, 축대 붕괴 등이 우려된다”며 “안전 조치를 강화하고 주민 대피 체계를 점검하라”고 했다. 특히 “지난 호우로 침수 피해를 본 지역이 이번 비로 다시 피해를 입지 않도록 긴급 점검하고, 안전 확보를 위한 모든 조치를 하라”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han further said, “Considering it is both the summer vacation and holiday period, implement proactive safety measures, including prompt guidance and evacuation facilitation for tourists and campers.” (한 총리는 이어 “휴가철이자 연휴 기간임을 감안해, 관광객과 야영객에 대한 신속한 안내와 대피 유도 등 선제적인 안전 조치를 강구하라”고 했다.)

Additionally, the Prime Minister ordered, “Significantly strengthen monitoring activities in low-lying areas prone to flooding, such as semi-basement homes and underpasses, and immediately evacuate residents and restrict access when danger signs appear.” She also said, “Thoroughly pre-check drainage pumps to ensure they operate without failure.” (이와 함께 한 총리는 “반지하 주택이나 지하차도 등 저지대 침수 우려 지역에 대한 예찰(豫察) 활동을 대폭 강화하고, 위험 징후가 있을 때는 주민들을 즉시 대피시키고 출입을 통제하라”고 했다. 또 “배수 펌프가 고장 없이 작동할 수 있도록 사전에 점검을 철저히 하라”고 했다.)

Regarding disaster notifications, she urged, “Given the difficulty of timely evacuation when heavy rain falls late at night through dawn, when heavy rain or landslide warnings are issued, immediately implement resident evacuation guidance via disaster text messages or village broadcasts.” (재난 안내와 관련해서는 “늦은 밤부터 새벽까지 집중호우가 내릴 경우 제때 대피하기 어려운 점을 감안해, 호우·산사태 경보 등이 발령된 때에는 재난 문자나 마을 방송 등을 통한 주민 대피 안내를 즉각 실시하라”고 당부했다.)

The Prime Minister expressed concern that “heavy rain could be concentrated in specific areas for short periods, leading to greater damage,” and instructed, “Maintain emergency duty status for officials from local governments, the Korea Forest Service, police, fire authorities, and other related agencies.” (한 총리는 “호우가 특정 지역에 단시간에 집중돼 피해가 커질 수 있다”고 우려하면서 “지방정부와 산림청, 경찰, 소방 등 관계자들의 비상 근무 태세를 유지하라”고 했다.)

According to the Korea Meteorological Administration on the 17th, strong rainfall of 30 to 50 mm per hour, accompanied by gusts, thunder, and lightning, is forecast mainly for the Seoul metropolitan area, Gangwon Province, and Chungcheong region from early morning to morning on the 18th. The Seoul metropolitan area, inland Gangwon, South Chungcheong, and northern North Chungcheong could see rates of 50 to 80 mm per hour. (17일 기상청에 따르면, 18일 새벽에서 오전 사이 수도권과 강원도, 충청권을 중심으로 돌풍과 천둥·번개를 동반한 시간당 30~50㎜의 강한 비가 내릴 것으로 전망된다. 수도권과 강원 내륙, 충남, 충북 북부는 시간당 50~80㎜까지 내릴 수 있을 것으로 예상된다.)

item.title: National Assembly Puts Shin Ik-hee Ahead of Rhee Syngman... Constitution Day Celebration Turns into Partisan Event (이승만 아닌 신익희 앞세운 국회... 진영 행사 된 제헌절 경축식)
item.description:
National Assembly Puts Shin Ik-hee Ahead of Rhee Syngman... Constitution Day Celebration Turns into Partisan Event (이승만 아닌 신익희 앞세운 국회... 진영 행사 된 제헌절 경축식)

The "Constitution Day Celebration" was held at the National Assembly on the 17th. It was the first such event since Constitution Day was reinstated as a public holiday after 18 years. (17일 국회에서는 ‘제헌절 경축식’이 열렸다. 제헌절이 18년 만에 다시 공휴일로 지정된 뒤 처음 열린 행사다.)

During the celebration, a video was screened using artificial intelligence (AI) technology showing the 198 members of the first National Assembly reciting the preamble to the founding Constitution. However, the first person to appear was not Rhee Syngman, the first Speaker of the first National Assembly, but Shin Ik-hee, a former National Assembly Speaker who initially served as Deputy Speaker and later became Speaker. Former President Rhee appeared second, following former Speaker Shin. (이날 경축식에선 인공지능(AI) 기술을 활용해 제헌 국회의원 198인이 제헌헌법 전문(前文)을 낭독하는 동영상이 상영됐다. 그런데 가장 먼저 등장한 사람은 제헌 국회 초대 의장이었던 이승만 전 대통령이 아닌, 초대 국회 부의장이었다가 이후 의장을 맡은 신익희 전 국회의장이었다. 이 전 대통령은 신 전 의장에 이어 두 번째로 등장했다.)

Regarding the order, the National Assembly explained, "Former President Rhee served in the first National Assembly for only two months before becoming the first president. Former Speaker Shin drafted the first and second stages of the Constitution's preliminary text and served as both the first Speaker of the first National Assembly and the second Speaker, making him more symbolic in relation to the founding Constitution." They cited Rhee's brief tenure in the first National Assembly as the reason for placing the Deputy Speaker ahead of the first Speaker. (국회 측은 순서 배치에 대해 “이 전 대통령은 제헌 국회에서 2개월간 활동한 뒤 초대 대통령이 됐다”며 “신 전 의장은 제헌 헌법의 1·2단계 초안 작업을 하고 제헌 국회 의장과 2대 의장을 하는 등 제헌 헌법의 상징성이 더 크다는 점을 고려했다”고 설명했다. 이 전 대통령의 제헌 국회 활동 기간이 짧은 점을 감안해 초대 의장이 아닌 부의장을 앞세웠다는 것이다.)

However, inside and outside the Assembly, speculation arose that "Because National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik is from the Democratic Party of Korea, they placed former Speaker Shin at the forefront." The Democratic Party traces its political roots to the Democratic Party founded in 1955 by Shin and others, with Shin serving as its first leader. Reactions from the opposition included, "They didn't want Rhee, who is not from their faction, to come first," and "It's absurd that they couldn't leave Rhee out entirely and just inserted him in second place." (하지만 국회 안팎에서는 “조정식 국회의장이 더불어민주당 출신이기 때문에, 신 전 의장을 맨 앞에 세웠을 것”이라는 말이 나왔다. 민주당은 자신들의 정치적 뿌리를 1955년 신 전 의장 등이 창당한 민주당에 두고 있다. 신 전 의장은 민주당의 초대 당수였다. 야권에서는 “자기 진영 인사가 아닌 이승만이 1번으로 나오는 건 싫다는 것”, “이승만을 아예 빼지는 못하고 2번에 끼워 넣은 것도 어이없다”는 반응이 나왔다.)

In his celebratory address, Speaker Woo repeatedly referenced the March 1st Movement, the April 19 Revolution, the May 18 Democratization Movement, the June Democracy Uprising, and the December 3 martial law crisis. Woo stated, "The lifting of the December 3 martial law was an unprecedented victory for democracy in global constitutional history. The people protected the National Assembly, the Assembly protected the Constitution, and the Constitution ultimately saved the Republic of Korea." (조정식 의장은 이날 경축사에서 3·1 운동과 4·19 혁명, 5·18 민주화운동, 6월 민주항쟁에 이어 12·3 비상계엄 사태를 거듭 언급했다. 조 의장은 “12·3 계엄 해제는 세계 헌정사에 유례가 없는 민주주의의 승리였다”며 “국민이 국회를 지켰고, 국회가 헌법을 지켰으며, 헌법이 마침내 대한민국을 구했다”고 했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung held a separate Constitution Day event at the presidential office, primarily focusing on informing about the injustice of the December 3 emergency martial law. That afternoon, President Lee held a Citizens' Invitation Event at the presidential office to mark the launch of the "Light Committee," saying, "We have gathered here to commemorate the Light Revolution, where the people defended democracy with their own hands on Constitution Day." The Democratic Party has been calling this the "Light Revolution," attributing significance to citizens actively using smartphone flashlights and glowing cheering sticks at rallies during the emergency martial law. The Light Committee is a presidential advisory committee established in March to commemorate and carry forward this Light Revolution. (이재명 대통령은 청와대에서 별도의 제헌절 행사를 열었는데, 12·3 비상 계엄의 부당성을 알리는 내용이 주를 이뤘다. 이 대통령은 이날 오후 청와대에서 ‘빛의 위원회’ 출범 기념 시민 초청 행사를 열고, “제헌절을 맞아 국민 손으로 민주주의를 지켜낸 빛의 혁명을 기념하기 위해 이 자리에 모였다”고 했다. 민주당은 비상계엄 당시 시민들이 집회에서 휴대폰 불빛, 야광 응원봉 등을 적극 활용한 것에 의미를 부여해 이를 ‘빛의 혁명’이라고 불러왔다. 빛의 위원회는 이런 빛의 혁명을 기념·계승한다는 취지로 지난 3월 설치한 대통령 직속 위원회다.)

President Lee stated, "Our modern history has been a fierce struggle between forces that sought to undermine constitutional values and democracy and privatize power, and the people who defended their sovereignty against them. The emergency martial law declared in the dead of night on December 3, 2024, made us realize that the threat to democracy is not just a thing of the past but can repeat itself at any time in today's Republic of Korea." He added, "We still vividly remember that tense moment when helicopters carrying martial law troops tore across the Seoul sky and armed special forces broke through the windows of the National Assembly to enter. I will designate December 3 of every year as 'People's Sovereignty Day,' so that all citizens can remember that day together and ensure the values of democracy are fully passed on to future generations forever." (이 대통령은 “우리 현대사는 헌법 가치와 민주주의를 훼손하고 권력을 사유화하려는 세력과 그에 맞서 주권을 지켜온 국민의 치열한 투쟁이었다”며 “2024년 12월 3일 한밤중에 선포된 비상계엄은 민주주의에 대한 위협이 결코 과거의 일이 아니라 오늘날 대한민국에서도 언제든지 되풀이될 수 있다는 것을 깨닫게 했다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “계엄군을 태운 헬기가 서울 상공을 가르고 무장한 특수부대가 국회의 창문을 깨고 진입하던 그 긴박한 순간을 우리들은 아직도 생생하게 기억한다”며 “매년 12월 3일을 국민주권의 날로 지정해 국민 모두가 그날의 일을 함께 기억하고 민주주의의 가치가 다음 세대에 영원토록 온전히 계승될 수 있게 하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee watched director Lee Myung-se's documentary film "Ran 12·3," which covers the events before and after the emergency martial law, together with citizens attending the event. Kim Ou-joon participated in producing the film. Director Lee attended the event and referred to the president and his wife, along with the attending citizens, as "the lead actors of the film." (이 대통령은 이날 행사에 참석한 시민들과 함께 비상계엄 전후 상황을 다룬 이명세 감독의 다큐멘터리 영화 ‘란 12·3’을 함께 관람했다. 이 영화는 김어준씨가 제작에 참여했다. 이명세 감독은 이날 행사에 참석해 대통령 내외와 참석한 시민들을 향해 “영화의 주연 배우”라고 했다.)

The opposition argued that the Democratic Party, which controls the National Assembly, has distorted the meaning of Constitution Day—an event meant to be commemorated jointly by both ruling and opposition parties—to suit its own interests. People Power Party Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk said, "The Democratic Party, having seized control of the National Assembly, unilaterally dictated everything from the start, recklessly churning out bad laws and running amok. If the Democratic Party truly wishes to commemorate Constitution Day and reflect on its meaning, they should first reflect on how ashamed they should be compared to the political dignity shown by our predecessors." (야당은 국회를 장악한 민주당이 여야가 함께 기념해야 할 제헌절의 의미를 자신들 마음대로 변질시켰다고 주장했다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 “민주당이 국회를 장악한 채 원 구성부터 일방 통보했고 독단적으로 악법을 쏟아내며 폭주하고 있다”며 “민주당이 진심으로 제헌절을 기념하고 그 의미를 되새기고 싶다면, 과거 우리 선배들이 보여준 정치의 품격에 비해 자신들이 얼마나 부끄러운지 반성부터 해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea Builds 21 Rocket Artillery Facilities Near DMZ, Just 50 km from Seoul (北, DMZ 인근에 방사포 시설 21동 건설한 정황… 서울서 50㎞ 거리 )
item.description:
North Korea has constructed multiple new buildings near the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) that are believed to be rocket artillery facilities, as captured in satellite imagery, according to Radio Free Asia (RFA) on the 17th. The large-scale construction of these anti-South Korea rocket artillery buildings in an area just 50 km in a straight line from Seoul is interpreted as linked to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's directive to fortify the border along the DMZ. (북한이 비무장지대(DMZ) 인근에 방사포 관련 시설로 추정되는 여러 건물을 새로 건설한 것이 위성사진에 포착됐다고 미국의 자유아시아방송(RFA)이 17일 전했다. 서울에서 직선거리로 50㎞밖에 떨어지지 않은 지역에 대남 공격용인 방사포 관련 건물을 대대적으로 신축한 것은 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 지시한 DMZ 일대 국경선화와 관련 있다고 풀이된다.)

According to RFA, satellite images taken from 2023 to last year in the area south of Kaesong and north of the Han River revealed 21 structures, each about 52 meters long, built at various small North Korean military bases. These buildings feature high ceilings and long designs, with roads accessible to vehicles on both sides, and are connected to offices and other facilities. Considering their locations and structural design, RFA reported that they are likely used for storing and maintaining mobile launch vehicles (TELs) or rocket artillery used for missile launches. (RFA에 따르면 2023년부터 지난해까지 북한 개성시 남쪽과 한강 이북 일대를 촬영한 위성사진에서 길이 약 52ｍ의 건축물 21동이 소규모 북한군 기지 곳곳에 건설된 것이 포착됐다. 천장이 높고 긴 건물 양쪽에 차량 출입이 가능한 도로가 있고 사무실과 기타 시설이 연결된 형태였다. 건물 위치와 설계 구조 등을 감안할 때 미사일 발사에 이용되는 이동식 발사 차량(TEL) 또는 방사포를 보관·정비하는 시설로 활용될 가능성이 있다고 RFA는 전했다.)

Jacob Bogle, a private satellite imagery analyst in the U.S., told the outlet, "All 21 buildings have a central through-passage design, allowing vehicles to enter from one side and exit from the other, with roofs raised high enough to service missile or rocket launchers in an erected position." Joseph Bermudez, a senior researcher at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), stated, "This is about reinforcing forward-deployed forces. There would be no reason to build this many identical structures of this type unless additional assets are being deployed forward." Bruce Bennett, a senior research Fellow at the RAND Corporation, added, "These are most likely related to rocket artillery or TELs. Just 50 of North Korea's new mobile launch vehicles could fill 13 to 17 of these new buildings, and 600 mm rocket artillery along with short-range launchers could also be stationed there." (미국의 민간 위성 사진 분석가인 제이컵 보글은 이 매체에 “21개 건물 모두 차량이 한쪽으로 들어와 반대쪽으로 나갈 수 있는 중앙 관통형 구조”라며 “미사일 또는 로켓 발사대를 세운 상태에서 정비할 수 있도록 지붕이 높게 만들어졌다”고 했다. 미국 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)의 조셉 버뮤데즈 선임연구원은 “전방 배치 병력을 강화하려는 것”이라며 “추가 자산을 전방에 배치하려는 게 아니라면 이렇게 같은 형태의 구조물을 이만큼 지을 이유가 없다”고 했다. 브루스 베넷 미국 랜드연구소 선임연구위원은 “방사포 또는 TEL과 관련됐을 가능성이 가장 크다”며 “북한의 신형 이동식 발사 차량 50대만으로 신축 건물 13~17개 동을 채울 수 있고 600㎜ 방사포와 단거리 발사대까지 함께 배치할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

In May, Kim Jong-un convened commanders of divisions and brigades across the military and ordered them to "turn the southern border line (the armistice line) into an impregnable fortress," directing a strengthening of armed forces. He subsequently oversaw test launches of three types of artillery and missiles—240 mm guided rocket shells, tactical ballistic missiles, and tactical cruise missiles—destined for forward deployment. During the 9th Party Congress in February, Kim announced a five-year defense enhancement plan, previewing the expanded deployment of 600 mm rocket artillery capable of carrying tactical nuclear warheads and new 240 mm rocket artillery. (김정은은 지난 5월 전군의 사단 및 여단 지휘관들을 소집한 자리에서 “남부 국경선(휴전선)을 난공불락의 요새로 만들라”며 무장력 강화를 지시했다. 이후 최전방에 배치될 240㎜ 조종 방사포탄과 전술 탄도미사일, 전술 순항미사일 등 3종의 포·미사일 시험 발사도 참관했다. 김정은은 지난 2월 9차 당 대회 때 국방력 강화 5개년 계획을 발표하면서 전술핵 탑재가 가능한 600㎜ 방사포와 신형 240㎜ 방사포 증강 배치를 예고했었다.)

item.title: Russia, Militarily Close to North Korea, Says S. Korea-NATO Cooperation "Unacceptable" (北과 군사 밀착하는 러, 한국·나토 협력엔 “용납 못해”)
item.description:
Russia's Foreign Ministry conveyed to South Korea's ambassador in Moscow that defense cooperation between South Korea and NATO poses a "threat to Russia's security" and is "unacceptable." This appears to be a response to President Lee Jae-myung's proposal of a "Korea-NATO Defense Industry Partnership 2.0" during his attendance at the NATO summit in Turkey on July 7. (러시아 외교부가 주러 한국 대사에게 한국과 나토의 방산 협력이 “러시아 안보에 위협이 된다”며 “용납할 수 없다”는 입장을 전했다. 이재명 대통령이 지난 7일 튀르키예에서 열린 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의에 참석해 ‘한·나토 방위산업 파트너십 2.0’을 제안한 데 대한 반응으로 볼 수 있다.)

Diplomatic circles note that "Russia, which has been cozying up to North Korea since the Ukraine war, tacitly condoning its nuclear weapons in exchange for troops and ammunition, is now criticizing South Korea-NATO cooperation—a classic case of the pot calling the kettle black." Russia is suspected of transferring missile and satellite-related military technology to North Korea and attempting to transfer nuclear submarine technology as well. (외교가에서는 “우크라이나 전쟁 이후 북한과 밀착해 북한 병력과 탄약을 지원받는 대가로 북한의 핵보유를 묵인해 주고 있는 러시아가 한국과 나토의 협력을 문제 삼는 것은 그야말로 적반하장”이란 얘기가 나온다. 러시아는 북한에 미사일·위성 관련 군사 기술을 이전하고, 핵잠수함 관련 기술 이전도 시도하고 있다는 의혹을 받고 있다.)

According to TASS news agency, Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko met with South Korean Ambassador to Russia Lee Seok-bae on the 16th (local time). In a subsequent statement, the Russian Foreign Ministry said, "The Russian side expressed serious concern over South Korea's gradual tilt toward NATO through practical measures to deepen military cooperation and military technology collaboration." It added, "The results of such measures (cooperation with NATO) pose a threat to Russia's security," and deemed South Korea's "virtual participation in NATO's qualitative and quantitative rearmament process" as unacceptable. (타스통신 등에 따르면, 러시아 외교부의 안드레이 루덴코 차관은 16일(현지 시각) 이석배 주러 한국 대사를 면담했다. 러시아 외교부는 그 후 발표한 성명에서 “러시아 측은 한국이 나토와의 군사 협력, 군사 기술 협력을 심화하기 위한 실질적 조치 등을 통해 나토 쪽으로 점차 기울고 있는 것에 대해 심각한 우려를 표명했다”고 밝혔다. 또 “이런 조치(나토와의 협력)의 결과는 러시아 안보에 위협이 된다”며 “한국이 나토의 질적·양적 재무장 과정에 사실상 참여하는 것은 용납할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on July 7, President Lee said at the NATO Defense Industry Forum, "South Korea will be the most reliable partner," and proposed a "Korea-NATO Defense Industry Partnership 2.0," going beyond "current defense cooperation that merely involves weapons trading to jointly research, produce, and operate weapons systems." (앞서 이재명 대통령은 지난 7일 나토 방위산업 포럼에서 “대한민국이 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너가 되겠다”고 했다. 또 “단순히 무기 체계를 거래하는 현재의 방산 협력을 넘어 무기 체계를 함께 연구하고, 함께 생산하며, 함께 운용하자”며 ‘한·나토 방위산업 파트너십 2.0’을 제안했다.)

In response to Russia's statement, Seoul's foreign ministry said on the 17th, "Cooperation with NATO aims to strengthen each other's capabilities in defense, new technologies, and cybersecurity to enhance our respective roles and contributions to international peace and stability." It added, "The government continues necessary communication with Russia to stably manage Korea-Russia relations and protect our people and businesses." (러시아 측 성명과 관련해 우리 외교부는 17일 “나토와의 협력은 방산, 신기술, 사이버안보 등 다양한 영역에서 서로의 역량을 강화해 국제사회의 평화와 안정을 위한 각자의 역할과 기여를 강화하기 위한 것”이라며 “정부는 한·러 관계의 안정적 관리와 우리 국민과 기업의 보호 등을 위해 러 측과도 필요한 소통을 이어 나가고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

The foreign ministry reportedly assessed that the meeting between Deputy Minister Rudenko and Ambassador Lee was not an official "summons" to protest, as the schedule was pre-negotiated and other issues were also discussed. Normally, when summoning an ambassador to protest a diplomatic dispute, the visiting schedule is unilaterally notified. (외교부는 루덴코 차관과 이 대사의 면담 일정이 사전에 협의·조율됐고 실제로는 다른 현안도 논의했기 때문에, 우리 측에 항의하기 위한 ‘대사 초치(招致)’는 아니라고 판단한 것으로 전해졌다. 통상 외교적 갈등에 대해 상대국에 항의하기 위해 대사를 초치할 때는 내방 일정을 일방적으로 통보한다는 것이다.)

A security expert commented, "On the 15th, Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-wha temporarily returned to address U.S. dissatisfaction over issues like Coupang, and the next day, the ambassador to Russia heard concerns from Moscow about NATO cooperation. This seems to reflect the challenges facing South Korean diplomacy amid a trend where major powers assert their own interests without filter." (한 안보 전문가는 “15일에는 쿠팡 문제 등에 대한 미국의 불만을 전하기 위해 강경화 주미 대사가 일시 귀국했고, 이튿날에는 주러 대사가 러시아 외교부에서 나토와의 협력에 대한 우려를 들었다”며 “강대국들이 저마다 여과 없이 자국의 이익을 주장하는 시대적 흐름 속에 한국 외교가 처한 어려움을 보여주는 것 같다”고 평했다.)

Three weeks prior, on June 25, Ambassador Lee had also received "concerns" from Deputy Minister Rudenko about South Korea-U.S. joint military drills. At that time, the Russian Foreign Ministry stated they had "conveyed to South Korea that continued confrontational military activities by South Korea and the U.S. near the North Korean border are escalating tensions on the Korean Peninsula and the region," urging Seoul to "abandon policies of pressure and sanctions against North Korea and show willingness for peace through concrete actions, not just words." (이 대사는 3주 전인 지난달 25일에도 루덴코 차관과의 면담에서 한미 연합 훈련에 대한 ‘우려’를 전달받았다. 러시아 외교부는 당시 “북한 접경지 인근에서 계속되는 한국과 미국의 대결적 군사 활동이 한반도와 역내 전체의 긴장을 고조시키고 있다는 우려를 한국 측에 전달했다”며 “북한에 대한 압박과 제재 정책을 포기하고, 평화에 대한 의지를 말로만 그칠 것이 아니라 실질적인 행동으로 보여달라고 촉구했다”는 입장을 냈다.)

Analysts suggest that as Russia and North Korea have become "blood allies" since the Ukraine war, showing nearly perfectly aligned stances on regional and global issues, Russia's pressure on South Korea is also intensifying. North Korea, in a Korean Central News Agency commentary on the 17th, criticized South Korea and Japan for participating in the U.S.-led multinational maritime exercise RIMPAC, calling it "a fire game timed with the deepening military cooperation moves between South Korea, Japan, and NATO." (우크라이나 전쟁을 계기로 러시아와 북한이 ‘혈맹’이 되고, 역내·세계 문제에 대해 거의 완전히 일치된 입장을 보이면서 한국에 대한 러시아의 압박 수위도 높아지고 있다는 분석도 나온다. 북한은 17일 조선중앙통신 논평을 통해 한국·일본 등이 최근 미국 주도 다국적 해상 훈련인 림팩(RIMPAC)에 참가한 것을 비난하면서 이런 훈련은 “한·일과 나토와의 군사적 공조 강화 움직임이 심해지고 있는 것과 때를 같이하여 벌어지고 있는 불장난”이라고 했다.)

A diplomatic source said, "Not only are North Korea and Russia strengthening military cooperation, but their diplomatic messages are virtually becoming integrated," adding, "While there are concerns that recent issues like the Coupang incident could create rifts in South Korea-U.S. relations, we need to be vigilant about the deepening ties between North Korea and Russia." (외교 소식통은 “북한과 러시아가 군사 협력을 강화할 뿐만 아니라, 외교적 메시지도 사실상 일체화되고 있다”며 “최근 쿠팡 사태 등으로 한·미 관계에 균열이 생길 수 있다는 우려가 나오는 반면 북·러의 밀착은 심화되고 있다는 데 대해 경각심을 가질 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong Un Meets Wang Huning: "North Korea-China Friendship Treaty Safeguards Fundamental Interests of Both Countries" (왕후닝 만난 김정은 “북한·중국 우호조약 양국 근본 이익 수호”)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un met with visiting Chinese top political advisor Wang Huning, emphasizing that the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance (hereinafter the Friendship Treaty) "defines the strategic nature of the bilateral relationship and provides a strategic direction for it." <<> According to North Korea's Rodong Sinmun on the 17th, Kim made these remarks the previous day during a meeting with a Chinese Party and government delegation led by Wang Huning. He stated that the treaty "plays a significant role in safeguarding the 'fundamental interests' of both North Korea and China (DPRK and China) and in ensuring peace and security in the region and the world." In response, Wang Huning pledged to fully implement the agreements from last month's North Korea-China summit to "enhance political mutual trust and bilateral solidarity." <<> Signed in 1961 and marking its 65th anniversary this year, the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty stipulates that if either party is subjected to armed invasion and enters a state of war, the other party will "provide military and other assistance with all its might and without delay." It is considered analogous to the U.S.-South Korea Mutual Defense Treaty. During his visit to North Korea last month, Chinese President Xi Jinping also directly proposed to "grandly commemorate" the 65th anniversary of the treaty, stating that he aims to "elevate bilateral relations to new heights." This paved the way for successive visits: North Korean Premier Pak Thae Song's visit to China from the 10th to the 12th, followed by Wang Huning's visit to North Korea from the 15th to the 17th. <<> Analysts suggest that the two countries' emphasis on the Friendship Treaty amid ongoing high-level exchanges reflects a choice shaped by changes in the regional situation. In 2016, the 55th anniversary of the treaty, there were no mutual visits or large-scale events, with only an exchange of congratulatory messages between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping. This was due to a sharp downturn in bilateral relations following North Korea's fourth nuclear test in January of that year, which proceeded despite China's strong opposition. On the 60th anniversary in 2021, the impact of COVID-19 limited commemorations to modest receptions hosted by the two countries' embassies. <<> However, since Kim Jong Un attended a military parade marking the 80th anniversary of China's Victory Day last year, North Korea-China relations have begun to recalibrate. Recently, the two countries have demonstrated thoroughly aligned positions on regional issues such as Taiwan and Japan's rearmament. The Trump administration's airstrikes on Venezuela and Iran, under the banner of "peace through strength," may also have influenced North Korea and China's renewed emphasis on the Friendship Treaty. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 방북한 왕후닝 중국 전국인민정치협상회의(정협) 주석을 만나 북·중 우호협력상호원조조약(이하 우호조약)이 “두 나라 관계의 전략적 성격을 정의하고 전략적 방향을 제시해 준다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Government drives youth into gambling den, then takes credit for debt relief" (오세훈 “정부, 청년 투전판 내몰고 빚 탕감 생색”)
item.description:

He added, "This creates a society where only young people who work hard and faithfully repay their debts end up looking like fools." Referring to the KOSPI market's sharp declines and surges this year, which triggered 37 sidecar measures and 7 circuit breakers, he called it "a clear man-made disaster resulting from the government's approval and neglect of single-stock leveraged derivatives." <<>> Mayor Oh further stated, "In the midst of this, President Lee has again pushed for long-term overdue debt relief, even lashing out at concerns about moral hazard as 'irresponsible incitement.' He argued, "This tragedy in the capital market is turning into a domino bomb that will eventually spread to the real estate market." <<>> It has been reported that since his election in the June 3 local elections, Mayor Oh has requested private meetings with the presidential office four times. His plan was to have an open and candid discussion with President Lee about housing policies in the Seoul metropolitan area in private, ahead of the public Cabinet meeting. Sources say Mayor Oh's side first conveyed this intention to the presidential office just before President Lee's European tour (June 9–18). <<>> However, the presidential office reportedly showed little response. Mayor Oh's side is said to have repeatedly requested private meetings, suggesting, "How about discussing the direction of real estate policy in the Seoul metropolitan area together with Gyeonggi Governor Choo Mi-ae and Incheon Mayor Park Chan-dae, both from the Democratic Party?" The presidential office was said to have remained silent on this as well. <<>> The subsequent meeting between President Lee and Mayor Oh took place at the public Cabinet meeting on the 14th. After being interrupted once by Prime Minister Han Seong-sook, Mayor Oh said toward the end of the meeting, "I really wanted to discuss something related to Seoul's housing administration." But this time, President Lee replied, "Let's talk about that later." item.title: Concession on ‘Candidate Qualifications’ Follows Preference Voting—Jeong’s Inclusiveness or Tactical Move? (선호투표 이어 ‘후보 자격’ 양보… 鄭, 포용인가 포석인가)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea decided on the 17th to allow Assemblymember Song Young-gil and former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute Kim Yong, who had been embroiled in disputes over eligibility for the August 17th party convention, to run for party leader and Supreme Council member, respectively. Pro-Chung faction Supreme Council members objected, calling it “a stain on the Democratic Party’s history.” However, former party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who is running for party leader, appeared to side with competitor Song and key pro-Myung faction figure Kim, stating, “We are comrades and fellow soldiers.” Within the pro-Myung faction, some said, “Jeong is playing political games by adopting a ‘big-hearted cosplay’ to garner sympathy votes, such as readily accepting the preference voting system that could work against him recently.” <<> The issue of Song and Kim’s eligibility for the party convention erupted late on the 16th, just one day before the candidate registration deadline. The party’s election commission deemed that the two did not meet the eligibility requirements for candidacy. According to party rules, candidates for party office must have paid party dues for at least six months within the 12 months prior to the candidate registration date. However, Song had been incarcerated over the “money envelope scandal” and was only reinstated into the party about four months ago after his acquittal was finalized in February, failing to meet this requirement. Meanwhile, Kim was detained on charges of illegal political fund receipt and released on bail in August last year, during which his financial accounts were frozen, preventing him from paying dues. Consequently, the leadership held an emergency closed-door Supreme Council meeting that night but failed to reach a conclusion. <<> The leadership reconvened the Supreme Council on the morning of the 17th and decided to grant exceptions for the two. They applied the exemption clause for “cases involving special circumstances,” specifically accepting the argument from Song and Kim that “time taken away by the prosecution cannot be grounds for disqualification.” <<> However, the three pro-Chung faction members among the six Supreme Council members strongly protested, calling it a “violation of party rules.” A Democratic Party official noted, “Since former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Assemblymember Song Young-gil are effectively aligned with the pro-Myung faction, it would be advantageous for Jeong’s side to sideline Song.” The closed-door meeting saw heated exchanges, but ultimately, the decision to allow exceptions was made. Pro-Chung Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok stormed out of the meeting just before the vote, telling reporters, “How can someone aiming to be party leader not know the party rules?” He also alleged, “Song told a certain Supreme Council member, ‘I’ll end your political career.’” Another pro-Chung Supreme Council member, Park Gyu-hwan, said after the decision, “I’m ashamed to have been present here.” <<> However, former leader Jeong reacted differently, posting on Facebook, “Since there is a relief clause in the party rules, the party leadership should handle it smoothly.” The post garnered hundreds of comments like “I support Jeong Cheong-rae.” <<> Jeong also stated that he would “coolly accept” the preference voting system, which many had recently assessed as unfavorable to him. Preference voting is a method where, in the absence of a majority vote-getter, voters rank candidates in a single round to avoid a runoff between the top two. Pro-government circles analyzed that this method benefits former Prime Minister Kim and Assemblymember Song. The pro-Chung faction strongly opposed it, calling it a “violation of the party constitution and rules” and “designed to defeat Jeong Cheong-rae.” Pro-Chung Assemblymember Lee Seong-yoon even resigned from his Supreme Council position in protest against the leadership’s decision. <<> Yet, the directly affected Jeong himself said, “I respect it from a grand perspective.” Some within the pro-Myung faction reacted with “bewilderment.” A Democratic Party lawmaker commented, “Normally, Jeong would have pushed back hard, but it seems someone has meticulously crafted a script for him to fit the victim and underdog narrative.” There are also talk s that Jeong and pro-Chung lawmakers are dividing roles as “good cop” and “bad cop.” Even when facing fierce attacks from the pro-Myung faction, Jeong has maintained a defensive stance, saying, “If I’m hit, I’ll take it,” and “Getting beaten 2-to-1 or 3-to-1 hurts a lot. Please go easy on me.” Yet he persistently adds, “I believe party members will protect me.” <<> Jeong’s support base appears to be consolidating. On this day, Jeong said, “After a YouTube video went out saying I was short of 20 million won until the donation limit, 380 million won was deposited overnight,” adding, “I am tearfully grateful.” His YouTube subscriber count, which had peaked at around 706,000 and dropped to 662,000 during the party-government conflict phase, rose again to 685,000 in just the last ten days. (더불어민주당은 17일 8·17 전당대회 출마 자격 시비가 일었던 송영길 의원과 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장에게 각각 당대표, 최고위원 선거 출마를 허용하기로 결정했다. 친청계 최고위원들은 “민주당 역사에 오점을 남겼다”며 반발했다. 하지만 정작 당대표 선거에 나온 정청래 전 대표는 “우리는 동지이자 전우”라며 경쟁자인 송 의원과 친명계 핵심인 김 전 부원장 편에 서는 듯한 모습을 보였다. 친명계에선 “정 전 대표가 최근 자신에게 불리할 수 있는 선호투표제도 별다른 반발없이 수용하는 등 ‘대인배 코스프레’를 통해 동정표를 챙기려는 정치적 수를 쓰고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon and Lee Geon-tae to Hold Public Debate on Supplementary Investigation Powers on the 22nd (한동훈·이건태, 보완수사권 놓고 22일 공개 토론)
item.description:
Lee Geon-tae (first-term, Gyeonggi Bucheon C), a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea and a junior-senior colleague of a prosecutor, and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (first-term, Busan Buk-gu) will hold a public debate on the 22nd over the issue of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. Lee argues for the complete abolition of these powers, while Han advocates for their retention. (검사 선후배 관계인 더불어민주당 이건태(초선·경기 부천병) 의원과 무소속 한동훈(초선·부산 북갑) 의원이 오는 22일 검찰 보완수사권 문제를 두고 공개 토론을 한다. 이 의원은 보완수사권 완전 폐지를, 한 의원은 존치를 주장하고 있다.)

This face-to-face debate was initiated by Han’s proposal. On the 16th, Han posted on Facebook, addressing the Democratic Party, saying, "Let’s openly debate before the people why supplementary investigation powers are necessary and why their abolition goes against the public interest." (이번 맞장 토론은 한 의원이 먼저 제안해 성사됐다. 한 의원은 지난 16일 페이스북에 민주당을 향해 “국민 앞에서 보완수사권이 왜 필요한지, 폐지가 왜 국민의 이익에 반하는지 공개적으로 토론하자”고 했다.)

In response, Lee stated on the 17th, "Let’s debate—me, who spent 20 years as a prosecutor and directly experienced the reality of political prosecution as a lawyer for President Lee Jae-myung’s Daejang-dong case." Lee added, "Before the eyes of the people, I will explain step by step why abolishing supplementary investigation powers is necessary and why the prosecution should not retain investigative authority." Lee is currently running in the Democratic Party’s August 17 national convention for a supreme council seat. (이에 이 의원이 17일 “검사 20년, 그리고 이재명 대통령 대장동 사건 변호인으로 정치 검찰의 실상을 직접 겪었던 저와 토론하자”고 한 것이다. 이 의원은 “국민이 보는 앞에서 보완 수사권 폐지가 왜 필요한지, 검찰이 왜 수사권을 가져가서는 안 되는지 하나하나씩 말씀드리겠다”고 했다. 이 의원은 민주당 8·17 전당대회 최고위원 선거에 출마한 상태다.)

Han immediately signaled his acceptance. He said, "Representative Lee Geon-tae, who described himself as 'Lee Jae-myung's Daejang-dong lawyer,' has responded as the Democratic Party’s lead contender to my proposal for a debate on abolishing supplementary investigation powers." He continued, "After lawmakers Kim Han-gyu and Song Young-gil of the Democratic Party, as well as commentator Yoo Si-min, all declined, I had worried that an important debate might not happen, so I’m relieved. I will strive to make this a productive discussion from the public’s perspective, not a personal fight." (한 의원도 즉각 수락 의사를 밝혔다. 그는 “저의 보완 수사권 폐지 토론 제의에 스스로 ‘이재명 대장동 변호인’이라는 이건태 의원님이 민주당 대표 선수로 응해주셨다”고 했다. 그러면서 “민주당 김한규·송영길 의원, 유시민 평론가까지 모두 거절하시길래 중요한 토론이 성사되지 않나 (걱정)했는데 다행”이라며 “감정 싸움이 아니라 국민의 관점에서 생산적인 토론이 되도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Han-gyu, who has been leading the Democratic Party’s task force on the complete abolition of supplementary investigations, had previously rejected Han’s debate offer, saying, "Stop playing media games and propose a bill instead." Former lawyer-turned-lawmaker Song Young-gil also declined, stating, "It would be proper to first apologize for criticizing cases where I was acquitted." (민주당 TF에서 보완수사 완전 폐지 법안을 주도해 온 김한규 의원은 한 의원의 토론 제안에 “언론플레이 말고 법안을 내라”고 했고, 변호사 출신 송영길 의원도 “내가 무죄난 사건을 비판했던 것부터 사과하는 게 예의”라며 거부했었다.)

Both Lee and Han are former prosecutors. The two sides have tentatively agreed to hold the debate at 5 PM on the 22nd on a comprehensive programming channel. Han said, "Representative Lee expressed a desire to debate on JTBC, and I agreed. As long as Lee consents to the venue and as many people as possible can watch, any location is fine." (이 의원과 한 의원은 모두 검사 출신이다. 양측은 오는 22일 오후 5시에 종합편성채널에서 토론하기로 잠정 합의했다. 한 의원은 “이 의원이 JTBC에서 토론하자는 의사를 밝히셨고, 저도 동의했다”며 “토론 장소는 이 의원이 동의하고 최대한 많은 국민이 보실 수 있으면 어디든 좋다”고 했다.)

item.title: "It's not a party line" "There's no directive" – The ruling party leadership ponders supplementary investigation powers (“당론 아니다” “지침 없다” 보완수사권 고심하는 與지도부)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea appears to be gradually retreating from its hardline stance of "completely abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers." After the prosecution's supplementary investigation uncovered the police's poor handling of the Jang Yun-gi case in Gwangju, Jeonnam, voices calling for retaining the supplementary investigation powers have grown louder, prompting the party to shift into a deliberation mode for now. However, key leadership contenders like former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, lawmaker Song Young-gil, and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae still maintain the stance of "complete abolition before the August 17 party convention." The Democratic Party leadership is deeply torn between public opinion and the demands of hardline supporters. <<> A key Democratic Party official told this newspaper in a phone call on the 17th that regarding the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which the leadership had been spearheading to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers, "There was a direction to push forward quickly, but there was no internal directive to process it before the party convention." The Democratic Party had planned to speed up the amendment of the Criminal Procedure Act, asserting that "the abolition of supplementary investigation powers is the principle," but the recent atmosphere is shifting. <<> Some within the leadership are reportedly considering a compromise that would allow exceptions for supplementary investigation powers. This would involve partially accepting the content of a bill, proposed by 11 lawmakers including Hong Ki-won, which opposes complete abolition and seeks to retain some supplementary investigation powers. Accordingly, discussions are underway to leave supplementary investigation powers in place for exceptional cases, such as sexual violence, child abuse, and violent crimes. <<> The change in the Democratic Party's stance stems from the growing opinion, triggered by the Jang Yun-gi case, that the prosecution's supplementary investigation function should be partially preserved. In fact, a Gallup Korea survey conducted from the 14th to the 16th found that even among those who positively evaluated President Lee Jae-myung's job performance, 49% favored retaining the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, while only 36% supported complete abolition. <<> Recently, the leadership under Han Byeong-do also reversed its position on the stance—set as party policy by the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership in February—of "complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers while maintaining the right to request supplementary investigations," saying, "That wasn't a party line." A lawmaker from the party's Criminal Procedure Act amendment task force (TF) said, "With the abolition of the prosecution service in October, hasn't the fundamental reform already been completed? The timing for deciding whether to exceptionally allow supplementary investigation powers is not something to be rushed." The Democratic Party has also decided to review jointly in the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee the bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers proposed by its TF and the bill to partially retain them proposed by moderate lawmakers. <<> Within the party, additional bills acknowledging limited supplementary investigation powers are expected to follow. Lawmaker Park Beom-kye and others are reportedly preparing Criminal Procedure Act amendments allowing exceptional supplementary investigation powers. A first-term lawmaker said, "I agree with exceptional allowances," and added, "I couldn't participate in the bill proposed by Hong Ki-won, so I plan to join when an additional bill is introduced that clarifies the scope of exceptions more clearly." <<> However, backlash from hardline supporters is intensifying. The 11 lawmakers who proposed the bill to partially retain the powers have been bombarded with text messages calling them "the 11 traitors of prosecution reform," demanding they resign as lawmakers, and threatening, "We won't vote for you next time." The three major leadership contenders—former Prime Minister Kim, lawmaker Song, and former leader Jeong—still insist, "Complete abolition is my intent." A Democratic Party official said, "Party convention candidates have no choice but to align with the sentiments of the hardline party members who come out to vote." The People Power Party countered, "Supplementary investigation powers are a safety device for the entire people," adding, "They're not a gift to be handed over lightly for a party convention." <<> The Democratic Party has decided to gather opinions through public debate for now. Acting floor leader and acting party leader Han Byeong-do said, "Since this is a bill directly related to the rights and interests of the people and the protection of victims, we will continue heated discussions and deliberations, broadly gathering opinions from the legal profession, academia, and civil society." On the 21st, the Democratic Party plans to hold a public debate inviting three professors in favor of the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers and three opposed. The discussion will cover the exceptional allowance of supplementary investigation powers and the overall criminal justice system, including mandatory police referrals. Separately, the Democratic Party will hold consecutive general meetings of lawmakers on the 20th and 21st to further collect internal opinions. (더불어민주당이 ‘검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 강경 기조에서 조금씩 물러서는 분위기다. 검찰 보완수사로 전남광주 장윤기 사건에 대한 경찰 부실 수사가 밝혀진 뒤 “보완수사권을 유지해야 한다”는 목소리가 커지자 일단 숙의 모드로 전환한 것이다. 하지만 차기 당권주자인 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원, 정청래 전 대표는 여전히 “8·17 전당대회 전 완전 폐지하자”는 입장이다. 민주당 지도부는 국민 여론과 강성 지지층 요구를 놓고 고심이 깊어지고 있다.)

item.title: Even CIO, Created to Check the Prosecution, Says “Reforms Needed if Supplementary Investigation Powers Are Abolished” (검찰 견제하려 만든 공수처도 “보완수사권 폐지땐 보완책 필요”)
item.description:
The Supreme Court, Ministry of Justice, Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) have expressed the position that complementary measures are necessary for the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that seeks the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. The four institutions that underpin the judicial and investigative system have issued a unified warning. (대법원·법무부·대검찰청·고위공직자범죄수사처가 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 보완책이 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 사법·수사 체계를 지탱하는 4개 기관이 한목소리로 경고한 것이다.)

In written responses submitted to the office of Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, the Supreme Court, Ministry of Justice, Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and CIO expressed concerns over investigative delays, confusion among investigative agencies, and loopholes in protecting the socially vulnerable that would arise from the abolition of supplementary investigation powers without alternatives. These institutions have repeatedly voiced concerns about the abolition of these powers in the past. (대법원·법무부·대검찰청·공수처는 국민의힘 주진우 의원실에 제출한 서면 답변서에서 대안 없는 보완수사권 폐지가 불러올 수사 지연, 수사기관 혼선, 사회적 약자 보호 공백 등을 우려했다. 이 기관들은 그동안 각자 보완수사권 폐지에 여러 차례 우려의 목소리를 내왔다.)

The Supreme Court stated, “If the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers are abolished, complementary measures need to be established to ensure that requests for supplementary investigations to judicial police officers (police) are promptly fulfilled.” It added, “The abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers is an issue that should be decided as a legislative policy matter through sufficient deliberation and review in the National Assembly.” (대법원은 “검찰의 보완수사권이 폐지된다면, 사법경찰관(경찰)에 대한 보완 수사 요구가 신속하게 이행되도록 하는 보완 방안이 함께 마련될 필요가 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지는 국회에서 충분한 숙의와 검토를 거쳐서 입법 정책적으로 결정할 사안”이라고 했다.)

The Ministry of Justice also said, “Supplementary investigations are a minimal safeguard for protecting wronged victims.” Regarding the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act proposed by a task force of the Democratic Party of Korea and currently pending before the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, it stated, “Abolishing supplementary investigation powers could lead to side effects such as gaps in protecting crime victims, severe investigative delays, difficulties in discovering substantive truth, and weakened advocacy for human rights,” adding, “If these powers are abolished without effective alternatives to address such side effects, public harm is inevitable.” (법무부도 “보완 수사는 억울한 피해자 보호를 위한 최소한의 안전장치”라고 했다. 이어 더불어민주당 TF가 발의해 현재 국회 법제사법위원회에 올라 있는 형소법 개정안에 대해 “보완수사권을 폐지할 경우 범죄 피해자 보호 공백, 심각한 수사 지연, 실체적 진실 발견 곤란, 인권 옹호 약화 등의 부작용이 발생할 수 있다”며 “이런 부작용을 해결할 수 있는 실효적 대안이 마련되지 않은 상태에서 보완수사권만 폐지하면 국민적 피해가 불가피하다”고 했다.)

The Supreme Prosecutors' Office likewise warned, “Abolishing supplementary investigation powers will only increase public suffering.” It cited the case of Jang Yun-gi in Gwangju, Jeonnam, where the prosecution’s supplementary investigations uncovered evidence tampering and poor investigations by the police, stating, “Supplementary investigation powers are the most critical tool for protecting the rights of the socially vulnerable,” and “Through the prosecution’s supplementary investigations, the truth of buried cases could be brought to light.” (대검찰청 역시 “보완수사권이 폐지되면 국민 고통만 가중될 것”이라고 경고했다. 또 검찰의 보완 수사로 경찰의 증거 인멸 및 부실 수사 정황이 드러난 전남광주 장윤기 사건을 거론하면서 “보완수사권은 사회적 약자의 권리 구제를 위한 가장 중요한 방안”이라며 “검찰의 보완 수사로 암장된 사건의 실체를 밝힐 수 있었다”고 했다.)

The CIO, an investigative agency established by the Democratic Party to check the prosecution, also expressed concerns about a “legislative vacuum” resulting from the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. It referenced the case of the “13 billion won bribery case involving an audit agency official,” which was ultimately dismissed (no charges) in May due to confusion between investigative agencies, pointing out that legislation had not been enacted for the supplementary investigation procedures of cases investigated by the CIO and forwarded to the prosecution. Rep. Joo Jin-woo stated, “The Democratic Party must take full responsibility for the public harm caused by the abolition of supplementary investigation powers.” (검찰 견제 목적으로 민주당이 주도해 설치한 수사기관인 공수처 또한 보완수사권 폐지에 따른 ‘입법 공백’을 우려했다. 지난 5월 수사기관 간의 혼선으로 결국 불기소(무혐의) 처리됐던 ‘감사원 공무원 13억 뇌물 수수 사건’을 거론하며 공수처가 수사해 검찰로 송부한 사건의 보완 수사 절차에 관한 법제화가 이루어지지 않았다고 지적한 것이다. 주진우 의원은 “민주당은 보완수사권 폐지에 따른 국민적 피해에 대한 책임도 모두 져야 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Skips Constitution Day Ceremony, Heads to Olympic Park (장동혁은 경축식 안 가고 올림픽공원으로)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, did not attend the 78th Constitution Day ceremony held at the National Assembly on the 17th. This was a form of "boycott" in response to the Democratic Party of Korea refusing to accept the People Power Party's demands in negotiations over the formation of the second half of the National Assembly and the right to recommend a special counsel for the Election Commission. Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik initially considered skipping the Constitution Day ceremony but announced late the previous night that he would attend "for the greater good" and appeared at the event. <<> Instead of the Constitution Day ceremony, Jang attended a rally at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, that afternoon, protesting the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections. Wearing a necklace engraved with a photo of former President Syngman Rhee, Jang arrived at the scene and wrote handwritten placards with phrases such as "Olympic Park Revolution: June 3 Citizen Revolution – Safeguarding Voting Rights" and "Citizen Special Counsel: Restoring Voting Rights, Defending Democracy," which he distributed to rally participants. Among the crowd, Jang picked up a megaphone and repeatedly chanted slogans like "Election fraud, re-election, same-day voting, manual count." <<> In a YouTube interview with Pen and Mic on the same day, Jang stated, "I did not attend the Constitution Day event as a protest against the collapse of constitutional order. I came to Olympic Park to see the citizens who are in the square shouting to restore voting rights and constitutional order." He added, "I believe that standing with these angry citizens on the Olympic Park grounds represents a centrist expansion." Since the ballot shortage incident, Jang has been attending the evening rallies at Olympic Park almost daily in his personal capacity, unless he has other scheduled engagements. He has also visited rallies across the country, including in Incheon, Busan, and Gwangju, Jeonnam, accompanied by some party leadership members. <<> However, criticism within the party over Jang’s off-National Assembly activities is mounting. A senior People Power Party lawmaker remarked, "While it's important to listen to the voices of citizens in the square, as the opposition leader, he must bring those issues to the National Assembly, engage in dialogue and compromise with the ruling party, and propose solutions. Continuing to remain outside the assembly only looks like an attempt to avoid the decline in his leadership since the local election defeat." <<> Park Seong-hoon, the party’s senior spokesperson, commented on the differing schedules of Jang and floor leader Jeong, saying, "While the party leader focuses on rallying the support base through clear messaging, the floor leader is playing a role in expanding the conservative base and reaching out to centrist voters." This is framed as a kind of "two-track strategy." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 17일 국회에서 열린 제78주년 제헌절 경축식에 불참했다. 더불어민주당이 후반기 국회 원(院) 구성과 선관위 특검 추천권 협상에서 국민의힘 요구를 수용하지 않고 있는 데 대한 ‘보이콧’ 성격이었다. 정점식 원내대표도 당초 제헌절 경축식 불참을 검토했으나, 전날 밤 “대승적 차원에서 참석하겠다”는 뜻을 밝히고 이날 행사에 자리했다.)

item.title: Chung Sye-kyun: "Next Year Is an Election-Free Year, the Right Time for Constitutional Amendment Discussions" (조정식 “내년은 선거 없는 해, 개헌 논의 적기”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Chung Sye-kyun said in a commemorative speech on the 78th Constitution Day on the 17th, "Let's prepare a 'People's Sovereignty Constitutional Amendment' by 2027, when the 1987 Constitution turns 40, and finalize the constitutional amendment within the 22nd National Assembly." The Democratic Party of Korea urged the People Power Party to join in forming a special committee on constitutional amendment in the National Assembly. However, the People Power Party rejected the proposal, stating, "The call for constitutional amendment raised as an extension of constitutional monopoly is a card pulled out only for strategic interests and self-preservation." <<> Speaker Chung said at the Constitution Day ceremony held at the National Assembly, "Next year has no nationwide simultaneous elections, making it the right time for the Assembly to calmly discuss constitutional amendments," adding, "I will launch an advisory committee on constitutional amendment directly under the Speaker to outline a roadmap and agenda for the amendment." He further outlined a plan to "form a special committee on constitutional amendment in consultation with all political parties and discuss the amendment proposal step by step." Speaker Chung proposed including the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the amended constitution, and incorporating in the main text restrictions on the president's power to declare martial law, restructuring of power, electoral management reform, and reinforcement of the separation of powers. He suggested a 'one-point constitutional amendment' primarily for reforming the National Election Commission, among other issues. <<> Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, also said on Facebook the same day, "Discussion on constitutional amendment to open a new future for the Republic of Korea is a task of the era that can no longer be postponed." He added, "Let's form a special committee on constitutional amendment in the National Assembly as soon as possible," urging, "The ruling and opposition parties must put their heads together to discuss the content, procedures, and plans for a national referendum on the amendment." He continued, "Constitutional amendment is not about the interests of a specific party but about establishing a century-long plan for the Republic of Korea." <<> The People Power Party, through a commentary by Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon, stated, "Constitutional amendment is a national affair that must be carefully discussed based on national consensus and the demands of the times," adding, "The current proposal for constitutional amendment is an unacceptable ambition and idea that brutally shakes the constitutional order." It further said, "The People Power Party will never turn a blind eye to any attempt to reduce the constitution, the foundation of the nation, to a tool for maintaining power." (조정식 국회의장은 17일 78주년 제헌절 기념사를 통해 “87년 헌법이 40돌을 맞는 2027년에 ‘국민주권 개헌안’을 마련하고, 22대 국회 내에 개헌을 매듭짓자”고 했다. 더불어민주당은 국민의힘에 국회 개헌특위 구성에 동참해 달라고 했다. 하지만 국민의힘은 “헌법적 독주의 연장선상에서 제기되는 개헌 주장은 정략적 이해관계와 안위만을 위해 꺼내 든 카드”라며 제안을 거부했다.)

item.description:

item.title: 61% Say Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Powers Should Be Maintained (검찰 보완수사권 61%가 “유지해야”)
item.description:
A public opinion survey released on the 17th shows that 6 out of 10 South Koreans oppose the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, which the Democratic Party of Korea is pursuing. Notably, opposition was even higher in the Honam region, a traditional stronghold of the Democratic Party. The Democratic Party, which had originally vowed to push through a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish these supplementary investigation powers before the August 17 national convention, is now shifting its stance, stating that it will "listen to public opinion and deliberate sufficiently." (국민 10명 중 6명은 더불어민주당이 추진 중인 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지에 반대한다는 여론조사 결과가 17일 나왔다. 특히 민주당 텃밭인 호남에서도 반대 여론이 더 높았다. 당초 8·17 전당대회 전 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안을 강행 처리하겠다고 했던 민주당도 “국민 여론을 들으며 충분히 숙의하겠다”는 입장으로 선회 중이다.)

According to a Gallup Korea survey conducted from the 14th to the 16th with 1,003 adults nationwide regarding the continuation or abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, 61% responded that "they should be maintained to check the police and prevent inadequate investigations." Only 23% said they should be "completely abolished in line with the principle of separating investigation and prosecution." (한국갤럽이 14~16일 전국 성인 1003명을 대상으로 검찰 보완수사권 존폐에 대한 의견을 물은 결과 61%는 ‘경찰 견제와 부실수사 방지를 위해 유지해야 한다’고 답했다. ‘수사·기소 분리 원칙에 따라 전면 폐지해야 한다’는 응답은 23%에 불과했다.)

Even among Democratic Party supporters, the response to maintain the powers was higher at 46%, compared to 39% who favored abolition. Among moderates, 64% supported maintaining them, while 23% favored abolition, with the maintenance opinion nearly three times higher. In the Honam region, the maintenance stance dominated at 55%, overwhelming the abolition stance at 28%. Analysts suggest that public opinion favoring the need for supplementary investigation powers has grown following the case of Jang Yun-gi in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, where the prosecution's supplementary investigation revealed instances of inadequate police investigations. (특히 민주당 지지층에서도 유지 46%·폐지 39%로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 응답이 더 높았다. 중도층은 유지 64%·폐지 23%로 유지 여론이 세 배 가까이 높았다. 호남에서도 유지론이 55%로 폐지론(28%)을 압도했다. 검사의 보완수사로 경찰의 부실수사 정황이 드러난 전남광주 장윤기 사건을 계기로 보완수사권이 필요하다는 여론이 높아지고 있다는 분석이다.)

Opposition to the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers is coming not only from legal circles but also from women's groups and some within the ruling party. The four major institutions—the Supreme Court, the Ministry of Justice, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials—have also voiced concerns in unison about abolishing the supplementary investigation powers without an alternative. On the 14th, 11 Democratic Party lawmakers proposed a bill to partially retain these powers. (법조계는 물론 여성단체, 여권 일각에서도 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 반대하고 있다. 대법원·법무부·대검찰청·공수처 등 4대 기관도 한목소리로 대안 없는 보완수사권 폐지에 우려를 표했다. 지난 14일 민주당 의원 11명이 보완수사권을 일부 존치하는 법안을 발의하기도 했다.)

The Democratic Party's leadership had previously declared that "there are no internal disagreements" and vowed to completely abolish the supplementary investigation powers through a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act by August. However, the atmosphere is now shifting toward deliberation. Nevertheless, hardliners continue to oppose, calling it a "retreat from prosecution reform." (민주당 지도부는 그동안 “당내 이견은 없다”며 8월 안에 형소법 개정을 통해 보완수사권을 완전 폐지하겠다고 공언했다. 하지만 숙의하자는 쪽으로 기류가 바뀌고 있다. 다만 강경파들은 여전히 “검찰개혁 후퇴”라며 반발하고 있다.)
